You set the model and the standard of rigor, the team implements it. Re-define the full-funnel measurement framework: which few metrics per marketing area actually anticipate revenue, how they connect to demos and MRR, and what we stop measuring. Establish how we measure the dark funnel — PR, brand, and offline — so investment decisions aren't biased toward whatever happens to be trackable. Own board and investor reporting: build the system that surfaces the metrics the board cares about in real time, define the cadence, and come to every board meeting with the causes, levers, and timelines behind every number. Cross-functional Partner with the Head of Sales on a joint MKT–Sales roadmap: lead quality, SLAs, handoff, enablement, and a shared definition of a qualified opportunity.
